_howTo: Home page 'Now on the Shelf'. Add, remove or reorder items. tag is a short label like "New Arrival", "Staff Pick" or "Michigan Favorite" (or ""). category is a short label like Wine, Beer, Bourbon, Spirits or Cigars. photo is optional: put a file in src/assets/photos/ and write its file name here.

items.name: Blanton's Original Single Barrel
items.note: The original single barrel bourbon. Soft caramel, orange and vanilla. Grab it when you see it.

items.name: Caymus Cabernet Sauvignon
items.note: A rich, velvety Napa Valley Cab with dark fruit and cocoa. A steak-night classic.

items.name: Bell's Two Hearted Ale
items.note: Michigan's iconic IPA from Kalamazoo. Bright, piney and always in the cooler.

items.name: Arturo Fuente Hemingway
items.note: A beloved perfecto-shaped smoke: smooth, rich and perfect with a pour of bourbon.
